text: Both tree transition directions cancel childList.animation, remove the opposite animating class and set their own class before starting an animation. Completion clears the class, commits height/hidden state, cancels the fill effect and deletes the animation handle. Recommend keeping that state sequence in this widget when adding interrupted transition behavior; rapid repeated toggles were not executed. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. title: Cancel an old tree animation before switching its state classes
